name: ACI 318-19 + ASCE 7-22
description: The US pack: ASCE/SEI 7-22 loads (combinations Sec 2.3-2.4, live loads and reduction Ch 4, seismic Ch 11-12 from the site's mapped spectral values, wind Ch 26-30, roof snow Ch 7) and ACI 318-19 structural concrete: strength reduction by strain (21.2), one-way shear with the size effect (22.5), two-way shear (22.6, with prestress 22.6.5.5), deflection with the 2019 effective inertia (24.2.3.5), crack control (24.3), shrinkage steel 0.0018 (24.4), development with the grade factor, the 2019 hooked and headed bar lengths (25.4), laps (25.5), columns (10), walls (11) and special walls (18.10: boundary elements by 1.5 du/hw, the amplified design shear, wall piers, coupling beams), special moment frame members and joints (18.6-18.8), slabs (8: direct design and equivalent frame), composite members (16.4), strut-and-tie (23). Steel (AISC 360-22), masonry, timber and the geotechnical tables fall back to the pack it extends (BNBC 2020), and the report names them. Every value has its clause in VERIFY.md, to be checked against the printed standards.

sources.title: Minimum Design Loads and Associated Criteria for Buildings and Other Structures (ASCE/SEI 7-22)
Building Code Requirements for Structural Concrete (ACI 318-19)

locations: ASCE 7-22 Sec 11.4.2, 26.5.1, 7.2: site values from the ASCE Hazard Tool
designClauses: ACI 318-19 and ASCE 7-22: the clause references of the concrete member design checks
citations: ACI 318-19: the concrete clause references of the report, worksheets and drawings
foundations: ACI 318-19 Chapter 23 (strut-and-tie); geotechnical values: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Chapter 3
